caption: Frame 1 runs from 0 to 25 ms, and every later frame starts 160 samples (10 ms) after the one before, so neighbours overlap by 15 ms. This overlap is the time axis of the spectrogram: 1.00 s of speech gives 98 such frames, and each frame's 512-point DFT becomes one column.

spec.aria: Five overlapping 25 ms frames of speech; each frame starts 10 ms after the previous one, so consecutive frames share 15 ms of signal, and 1.00 s of speech yields 98 frames.
